svg.title: Scoreboard: 7 mistakes in the AI's code against 9 kinds of check
svg.desc: A grid with one row per mistake and one column per kind of check. A number is how many tests of that kind failed when the mistake was put back; a dash means none did; a tick means the code review found it by reading.
svg.text: What caught each mistake the AI made
Number: tests of that kind that failed with the mistake put back. Dash: none did. Tick: found by reading the code.
